opening.argument: The presentation promotes paid OneCoin packages through a sponsor website and invites viewers to join, with packages priced at different levels and tied to token allocations. It describes those tokens as “the keys to the mining pools,” presenting payment as access to a mining-based return structure. The opportunity also includes a “3X3 Matching Bonus” organized around sponsored-person levels, while the speaker expressly connects network marketing to commissions and bonuses from education-package sales. Together, these features present paid participation, mining-pool access, token allocations, member resale, and a recruitment-linked bonus structure as the basis for potential returns, including the stated possibility that token sales could exceed package costs and produce returns above 200,000 Euros. The future-value chart remains a prediction, and the presentation acknowledges possible token loss.
